pieces.Text: You can set a location as a full-round action that provokes attacks of opportunity when standing in the location.  As long as you are within 400 feet of the location, you can teleport to it as a standard action.  You can bring along
additional creatures of the same size or smaller than yourself that you are physically touching, although if the creature or creatures touched are unwilling, a Will save (DC
) leaves that creature behind.  Using this ability to teleport can only be done 1/day.
